backend/worker.py.purpose: Execution worker process: claims queued tasks into attempts, drives native Hermes runs over HTTP, ingests runtime events, settles results, advances waiters, and hosts intake/monitor/routine/teaching background loops.
responsibilities: Main 1-second loop: provisioning outbox, readiness probe, work controller reconcile, waiter advancement, knowledge proposals, connector dispatch, claim/drive attempts
claim_new: global advisory lock, capacity, per-bot exclusivity, SKIP LOCKED lock order, preflight checks, session mapping, prompt assembly, attempt insertion
claim_existing: lease takeover of active attempts after 12s lease expiry (crash recovery)
drive: start run with Idempotency-Key, poll status, stream events, budget accounting, deliver decisions/steering, queue monitor assessments
settle: map runtime terminal status into task state machine, bounded automatic recovery, outcome settlement, result message
advance_waiters: request expiry closure, coordination wakeups, waiting_input/computer resume, dependency release, child result resumption, deadline/grant expiry stops
System policy prompts (POLICY / MANAGED_POLICY / COORDINATION_POLICY)

Background loops started from main(): execution_monitor.run, work_intake.run, routines.run and teaching.run (teaching maintenance + candidate-generation loops); all four are cancelled and gathered in the finally block

main() starts teaching.run(STOP) as a fourth background asyncio task (teaching_sync) next to monitor, intake and routine_sync.
Shutdown cancels teaching_sync and includes it in the gather(return_exceptions=True) with the other loops.

notes.text: WORKER_ID is a fresh UUID per process; leases are 12 seconds; claim_existing takes over expired leases with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED.
claim_new serializes admission with pg_advisory_xact_lock(887832103) and bounds concurrency by workspace max_active minus active/reserved attempts.
A DB unique partial index allows one active attempt per bot (including uncertain).
Native dispatch idempotency: Idempotency-Key 'hermbot:{attempt_id}' re-sent on retry; after 23h the attempt is marked uncertain instead of replaying.
Automatic recovery only for definite retryable failures before any tool started with complete event coverage, bounded by MAX_RECOVERIES.
teaching.run is async: it gathers two thread-offloaded 1-second loops, maintain and generate_one, swallowing their exceptions.

docker/runtime_api.py.purpose: Private per-bot FastAPI adapter (port 8643) exposing native Hermes knowledge, workspace export, Bot Desktop control/stream, teaching demonstration capture and routine-scheduler management to the Hermbot backend only.
responsibilities: Bearer auth against HERMBOT_ADAPTER_KEY with hmac.compare_digest
Safe knowledge file IO under HERMES_HOME via dir fds, O_NOFOLLOW, regular-file and UTF-8 checks, 100 000-char limit
Compare-and-swap writes keyed by sha256 with cross-process flock and atomic fsynced replace; same-content replay
Native memory (MEMORY.md/USER.md) read/write with Hermes limits and safety scan; skill catalog/read/write (hermbot- prefix editable)
Workspace file export for hermbot_publish_file (regular, single-link, no hidden parts, <=10 MB, stable during read)
Desktop status/start/stop/thumbnail/browser and takeover/handback using native bot_desktop lease + Hermbot gate drain + ready marker

RFB WebSocket relay to the native unix socket with RfbClientFilter gating input to the ready viewer (allowed() records the lease epoch admitted for that viewer); accepted client bytes are also parsed by AcceptedRFB and fed to the teaching Capture under capture.lock; capture.disconnect(viewer) runs when the socket closes

Teaching capture endpoints: POST /teaching/control (start|pause|private|resume|finish|discard, requires input-ready viewer and matching lease epoch except finish/discard) and GET /teaching/batch?ack=N (acknowledged event/frame batches) over a process-global teaching_capture.Capture; teaching_frame() takes a 1440x1000 thumbnail after 0.2 s
Pauses the teaching capture on takeover and on handback of the computer lease (capture.pause)
Manage the fixed no-agent 'Hermbot wake <generation>' cron job through Hermes CLI/API

changes_since_previous_pass.text: sys.path now also includes the adapter's own directory, and the module imports AcceptedRFB and Capture from teaching_capture; a process-global `capture = Capture()` is created.
/computer/control pauses the capture ('computer handed back' on handback, 'computer ownership changed' before takeover).

New TeachingControl model and POST /teaching/control: 409 unless the viewer is input-ready and the lease epoch matches (not required for finish/discard); finish on a recording session takes a last frame first; start/resume take a frame after control succeeds; ValueError becomes 409.
New GET /teaching/batch returning capture.batch(ack).

New async teaching_frame(): after 0.2 s reads desktop geometry, renders a 1440x1000 thumbnail in a thread, stores it with capture.frame, records geometry while still recording; any failure pauses capture ('Screen capture unavailable; retained prefix only').

/computer/ws: the input gate is now allowed(), a closure that records the lease epoch of the admitted viewer; receive() runs gate.feed and AcceptedRFB.feed/capture.observe inside capture.lock, pauses capture on unsupported protocol input, forwards bytes to the VNC socket, and schedules a teaching_frame for an observed generation; capture.disconnect(viewer) runs in the finally block.

plugins/hermbot/__init__.py.purpose: Hermes plugin 'hermbot': registers 22 hermbot_* tools, pre_llm_call/on_session_end hooks and tool_execution/llm_request middleware that route all collaboration through the authenticated backend /internal API (including consultation of a teaching candidate skill).
responsibilities: post(): JSON POST to HERMBOT_API_URL with Bearer HERMBOT_BOT_TOKEN; map HTTP errors to {error,status_code}; unavailability to a stop-and-report error

after_turn(): report turn completion to /internal/turn-ended

notes.text: Every pytest test is a DB-integration test in practice: the autouse session fixture initializes the real PostgreSQL schema and the autouse clean_database fixture truncates tables, regardless of whether a file declares pytestmark=integration.
Safety guard: the suite exits with return code 2 if DATABASE_URL does not end with /hermbot_test, so it can never truncate the product database.
Fixture depends on the three seeded bots researcher/writer/reviewer (Scout/Quill/Sage) existing; it deletes any other bots, group conversations and non-environment providers.

Workspace defaults reset per test: permitted_tools file/terminal/skills, max_bots=10, max_active=3, active_budget_seconds=3600, decision_mode disabled, external_action_mode requested, execution_policy_revision=1.

The TRUNCATE list omits several later tables (e.g. input_requests, work_outcomes, teammate_messages, routine_runs, trigger_events); they are cleared only through CASCADE from tasks/work_items/routine_definitions etc. (inferred from the explicit list).
